1.name: The Green Dragon

effects.text: When played, either mark 1 {mark} on green to hide, or face the dragon by doing the following 3 things in order (skip those you cannot perform): 1) Discard 3 friendly cards to mark 1 {mark}. 2) Cross out 1 production on 1 friendly card and discard it to mark 1 {mark}. 3) Destroy 1 friendly card to mark 1 {mark}. When the white track is complete, {flip}.

1.text: {triggeredForced} When played, either mark 1 {mark} on green to hide, or face the dragon by doing the following 3 things in order (skip those you cannot perform): 1) Discard 3 friendly cards to mark 1 {mark}. 2) Cross out 1 production on 1 friendly card and discard it to mark 1 {mark}. 3) Destroy 1 friendly card to mark 1 {mark}. When the white track is complete, {flip}.
1.helpText:
ERRATA: The third step of this card should specify friendly card "in play".
Note that if you face the dragon, you have to perform the steps in order, and in order to perform them you must perform them fully. So, if you have 2 friendly cards in play, you cannot perform step 1. If just 1 of your 2 cards has production, you have to choose that card for step 2 (if both have production, you can choose which one to perform the effect on). Step 3 would then destroy the last card. This would result in a total of 2 [mark] on the white track, since you couldn't perform step 1. Note that when all 3 steps have been performed (if possible), the attack is done and you continue with your turn as usual. As soon as the last white box is marked, this card is turned, even if you haven't performed all the steps. If you want to hide to avoid disaster, you can do so by marking [mark] in the green track. Note though, that it's only possible to mark 3 green [mark]. When the green track is full, this option is no longer possible.

description: ERRATA: The third step of the Green Dragon should specify friendly cards in play. This is 1 of the 10 adventures you can choose on your Adventure Map. Fighting this dragon is terrifying, but there's a lady in there who needs your help!
